description: Root-level stage contracts for book2game. Defines ownership, inputs, outputs and handoff gates per stage. A Stage claims ONLY what its contract declares.
contract_principle: No stage may claim outputs outside its declared outputs. Anything declared output but not verifiable is quarantined to canon/unresolved-ambiguities.json.

stages.label: Source Extraction
stages.handoff_gate: (full_text.md || source/full_text.md) exists && paragraph-hashes.file_hash == sha256(source/full_text.md) && document_ir.json exists && document_ir.file_hash present

stages.label: Canon Layer
stages.handoff_gate: every canon entity has _uuid and _epistemic==canon; relationships have _source_uuid/_target_uuid; ambiguous items quarantined
invariants: No hallucination: all canon traceable to paragraph hash

stages.label: Derived Layer (Cycles 5-12)
stages.handoff_gate: all JSON valid; each has evidence/citations or explicit open_space label; no FAKE_METRICS
invariants: Cycles 5-12 evidence-grounded; no hardcoded 99.8% / Nash / retention claims (quarantined if present)

stages.label: Projection Views
stages.handoff_gate: every assembled projection has IMMUTABLE_KERNEL.md with source_hash + canonical_uuids_present; kernel matches provenance
invariants: Self-contained: agent can produce deliverable without source lookup

stages.label: Whitebox Runtime Validation
stages.handoff_gate: whitebox-validation.json exists; deterministic==true; seed recorded; PASS requires robustness >= 0.6 else NEEDS_ATTENTION is non-fatal
invariants: Pure stdlib; no ML; deterministic with seed=42 by default
Top risk edge identified (highest fan-out / steepest tension drop)

stages.label: Contract Distribution
stages.handoff_gate: contracts/stage-contracts.json present in output; version matches repo contracts/stage-contracts.json
invariants: Stage ownership is authority: a stage may not claim an output outside its declared outputs

stages.label: Package Index & Handover (Phase 17 Phase 1)
stages.handoff_gate: _manifest.json valid && _handover.status in {PASS, NEEDS_ATTENTION}; document_ir.json exists && file_hash present; every authoritative:true exists; every authoritative:false has canonical_source
invariants: _catalog.md is thin view of _manifest.json — no independent authority

global_rules.ownership: Each artifact has exactly one owning stage. Duplicates are forbidden unless declared as derived copy in a later stage.
global_rules.anti_overclaim: Any claim not traceable to source_offsets or to a deterministic method with confidence is labeled open_space and quarantined if asserted as fact.
global_rules.determinism: All derived computations and whitebox simulation use fixed seed (42) and pure Python. No nondeterminism crosses a stage boundary.
global_rules.backward_compat: Legacy flat paths (e.g., entities.json at root) are deprecated wrappers pointing to canonical locations; their presence is non-fatal.
